## Walgreens FQ3 2025 Comparable Store Sales

**U.S. Retail Pharmacy Results:**
- **Comparable Pharmacy Sales:** +14.6%
- **Comparable Retail (Front-End) Sales:** -2.4% decline
- **Company-wide Retail Pharmacy Sales:** +7.8% ($30.7 billion)

Source: [Supermarket News](https://supermarketnews.com/finance/walgreens-q3-sales-get-a-boost-from-pharmacy-gains), [Winsight Grocery Business](http://www.winsightgrocerybusiness.com/finance/walgreens-q3-sales-get-a-boost-from-pharmacy-gains)

**Key Details:**
- Total company sales: +7.2% to $39 billion
- Pharmacy sales were the main driver, up 11.8%
- The retail comp decline (-2.4%) was attributed to weaker sales in grocery/household items, health & wellness products, and beauty, as well as the impact of store closures (423 stores closed in the first 9 months of fiscal 2025)
- Front-of-store retail sales overall fell 5.3%

Source: [PocketQuant](https://pocket-quant.com/blogs/0197abf5-b064-7246-bd29-3dc42e4df8c3/Walgreens%20Boots%20Alliance%20Q3%202025%20Financial%20Results%20Analysis%20and%20Strategic%20Outlook), [Futubull](https://news.futunn.com/en/notice/304923617/walgreens-boots-alliance-10-q-q3-2025-earnings-report)

claims.claim: Comparable pharmacy sales increased 14.6% in fiscal Q3 2025
claims.reason: The retrieved Supermarket News text says comparable pharmacy sales increased 14.6% versus the third quarter of the prior year. This is an actual quarterly result, not guidance.

claims.claim: Comparable retail sales declined 2.4% in fiscal Q3 2025
claims.reason: The retrieved text reports a 2.4% decline in comparable retail sales. It separately reports a 5.3% decline in front-of-store retail sales, so those are distinct measures.

claims.reason: Futubull reports that the U.S. Retail Pharmacy segment's sales rose 7.8% to $30.7 billion. That supports the figures and period, but not the answer's 'Company-wide' label: this is a segment, not total company sales.

claims.claim: Total company sales rose 7.2% to $39 billion
claims.reason: The retrieved article says overall third-quarter sales were up 7.2% year over year to $39 billion. The claim matches the actual Q3 result.

claims.claim: Pharmacy sales rose 11.8% and were the main driver

claims.reason: The retrieved article explicitly says Walgreens attributed the retail comp-sales decline to weaker sales in grocery and household items, health and wellness products, and beauty.
